mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO attachment (owner_id, owner_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type_id, uploader_id) VALUES
(#{item.ownerId}, #{item.ownerType}, #{item.fileName}, #{item.filePath}, #{item.fileSize}, #{item.mimeTypeId}, #{item.uploaderId})
mapper.select: SELECT , mt.name AS mime_type_name FROM attachment AS att LEFT JOIN mime_types mt ON att.mime_type_id = mt.id WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachment WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType}
